title.fa: تاریخِ فلسفی چونان رشتهٔ راهنما: برنهادِ نهمِ کانت
title.en: Philosophical history as a guiding thread: Kant's ninth thesis
title.nl: Philosophical history as a guiding thread: Kant's ninth thesis

summary.fa: آخرین برنهادِ رسالهٔ ۱۷۸۴ کانت می‌پرسد: آیا نوشتنِ تاریخِ جهان چنان‌که گویی به سوی یک هدف (اتحادِ مدنیِ کاملِ بشر) پیش می‌رود، خیال‌بافی است؟ پاسخِ کانت: نه اگر آن را فرضی راهنما بدانیم، نه ادعایی دربارهٔ واقعیت؛ رشته‌ای که آشفتگیِ کنش‌های بشری را دست‌کم در کلیت به یک نظام بدل می‌کند و خودش به تحققِ آن هدف کمک می‌کند.
summary.en: The last thesis of Kant's 1784 essay asks whether writing world history as if it moved toward a goal (the perfect civil union of humankind) is fantasy. Kant's answer: not if taken as a guiding assumption rather than a claim about reality; a thread that turns the chaos of human actions into a system, at least as a whole, and itself helps realise the goal.
summary.nl: The last thesis of Kant's 1784 essay asks whether writing world history as if it moved toward a goal (the perfect civil union of humankind) is fantasy. Kant's answer: not if taken as a guiding assumption rather than a claim about reality; a thread that turns the chaos of human actions into a system, at least as a whole, and itself helps realise the goal.

text.fa: یادداشتِ ویراستار: متنِ کاملِ ترجمهٔ فارسیِ باقر پرهام (۲۱ صفحه، نشرِ توانا) در دست است؛ این مدخل از برنهادِ نهم نوشته شده و چهار مدخلِ دیگرِ کانت از برنهادهای پیشین.
text.en: Editor note: the full Persian translation by Bagher Parham (21 pages, Tavaana) is at hand; this entry draws on the ninth thesis, the other four Kant entries on earlier theses.
text.nl: Editor note: the full Persian translation by Bagher Parham (21 pages, Tavaana) is at hand; this entry draws on the ninth thesis, the other four Kant entries on earlier theses.

text.fa: ادعا: کوششِ فلسفی برای نوشتنِ تاریخِ عامِ جهان بر پایهٔ طرحی از طبیعت که هدفش اتحادِ مدنیِ کاملِ نوعِ بشر است، باید ممکن و حتی یاری‌رسان به آن هدف دانسته شود.
text.en: Claim: a philosophical attempt to write universal history according to a plan of nature aiming at the perfect civil union of humankind must be regarded as possible and even as furthering that aim.
text.nl: Claim: a philosophical attempt to write universal history according to a plan of nature aiming at the perfect civil union of humankind must be regarded as possible and even as furthering that aim.

text.fa: اعتراضی که خودِ کانت پیش می‌کشد: چنین طرحی در نگاهِ اول عجیب و پوچ می‌نماید و ممکن است فقط به قصه‌ای خیال‌انگیز برسد. پاسخش: اگر فرض کنیم طبیعت بی‌هدف عمل نمی‌کند، حتی با آزادیِ انسان، این ایده می‌تواند رشتهٔ راهنمایی باشد هرچند سازوکارِ نهانِ طبیعت را نبینیم.
text.en: The objection Kant himself raises: such a plan looks strange and absurd and may yield only a romance. His reply: if nature does not act without purpose, even allowing for human freedom, the idea can serve as a guiding thread though we cannot see nature's hidden mechanism.
text.nl: The objection Kant himself raises: such a plan looks strange and absurd and may yield only a romance. His reply: if nature does not act without purpose, even allowing for human freedom, the idea can serve as a guiding thread though we cannot see nature's hidden mechanism.

text.fa: روش: از تاریخِ یونان شروع کن، اثرِ یونان بر روم و روم بر «بربرها» را تا امروز دنبال کن و فقط بر قانونِ اساسیِ مدنی، قوانین و مناسباتِ میانِ ملت‌ها تمرکز کن؛ آنگاه جریانی قاعده‌مند از پیشرفت دیده می‌شود: هر نظامی با نقص‌هایش فرو می‌ریزد ولی بذری از روشن‌شدگی می‌گذارد که با هر انقلاب رشد می‌کند.
text.en: Method: start with Greek history, follow Greece's influence on Rome and Rome's on the "barbarians" to the present, focusing only on civil constitutions, laws and relations between states; a regular progress appears, each order decaying through its flaws yet leaving a seed of enlightenment that grows with each revolution.
text.nl: Method: start with Greek history, follow Greece's influence on Rome and Rome's on the "barbarians" to the present, focusing only on civil constitutions, laws and relations between states; a regular progress appears, each order decaying through its flaws yet leaving a seed of enlightenment that grows with each revolution.

text.fa: کارکردِ دوگانه: این رشته هم بازیِ آشفتهٔ امورِ بشری را روشن می‌کند و هم به هنرِ پیش‌بینیِ سیاسیِ تغییرها درونِ هر ملت و میانِ ملت‌ها کمک می‌کند؛ و چشم‌اندازی امیدبخش می‌دهد که بی آن امیدِ معقول به آینده ممکن نیست.
text.en: Double function: the thread clarifies the confused play of human affairs and aids the art of political foresight within and between nations, and offers a hopeful prospect without which reasonable hope for the future is impossible.
text.nl: Double function: the thread clarifies the confused play of human affairs and aids the art of political foresight within and between nations, and offers a hopeful prospect without which reasonable hope for the future is impossible.

text.fa: نقدِ رایج (داوریِ ویراستار): این همان «تاریخِ غایت‌مند» است که بعدها هگل و مارکس آن را به قانونِ تاریخ بدل کردند، و منتقدانی چون پوپر نقدش کردند. تفاوتِ کانت این است که خودش آن را فرضِ تنظیمی می‌داند نه دانشِ قطعی؛ و محورش اروپاست، که خواننده باید آگاهانه کنار بگذارد.
text.en: A common critique (editor's judgement): this is the teleological history that Hegel and Marx later turned into a law of history, criticised by Popper and others. Kant's difference is that he treats it as a regulative assumption, not knowledge; and its Europe-centredness must be set aside consciously.

Kant's difference is that he treats it as a regulative assumption, not knowledge; and its Europe-centredness must be set aside consciously.
